verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM ships its own built-in AI agents. First-party sources describe 'AI Agents', 'RAG, agents, and work right out of the box', and a 'capable AI agent running on your device', and docs pages cover Agent Flows, custom agent skills and web scraping/search. The evidence is mostly headline-level, though, so how deep task delegation goes is thinly documented. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of what tasks the agent can carry out on the user's behalf, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent task delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
